class.name: SVG3D
class.brief_description: Renders SVG markup on a sprite in a 3D scene.
class.description: SVG3D rasterizes SVG markup onto an internal 3D plane. It monitors the active camera and updates at resolution boundaries while keeping its size in 3D space unchanged.

method.name: get_texture
method.description: Returns the texture currently displayed on the internal 3D plane.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], redraws the SVG at a higher texture resolution when it occupies more pixels through the active camera. The current power-of-two level is reused, and each texture axis is limited to 4096 pixels.
The size of one SVG unit in 3D space. Adaptive texture changes do not change this visible size.
The complete SVG markup to render on the 3D sprite. Load an SVG file as text and assign its contents here.
